cards.armingClassification: Creature copy/colour contribution, not spell quota. Pay arming once; reveal enters normally without a second payment.
cards.entryEffectProposal: While your board is empty, reveal this Guard creature in response to an attack aimed at your side. It enters normally; the declared attack must then obey legal Guard targeting. No extra Entrance effect.
